principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator and VolumeCalculator classes both handle more than one responsibility by aggregating areas and volumes in the same class hierarchy.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the area and volume calculations into different classes, ensuring that each class has a single responsibility.

principle_violations.reason: The Circle and Square implementations of the Shape interface throw an exception in the volume method, violating the Liskov Substitution Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the volume capability into a different interface so that only classes with volumetric calculations need to implement it.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
